thread:
aj: FYI getting a customer escalation — sustained 502/504s for hosted API in eu-west-1 since ~09:12 UTC. customer reports ~30% of requests failing

aj: Quick curl we captured: 
```bash
curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/2 502
server: envoy
date: Tue, 11 May 2026 09:14:01 GMT
content-length: 0
```

maria: :eyes: thanks — are there trace ids? any host headers / tenant id?

aj: got one from the customer: trace_id=trace-0a1b2c3d, tenant=acme-inc, route=/v1/generate, region=eu-west-1

kevin: I see a surge in envoy upstream_xxx errors around that time on the frontdoor loadbalancer. Logs show repeated "upstream connection failure" and "stream reset" patterns. Pasting a snippet: 
```
[envoy] 2026-05-11T09:13:58Z cluster: upstream_acme backend: connection failure: errno=104
[envoy] 2026-05-11T09:14:00Z stream reset reason: ECONNRESET
```

tara: Could be h2 keepalive pool exhaustion when tenant has large batch embeddings. Is this the same tenant that ran a big embed batch earlier?

aj: Customer said they ran a few large embedding batches yesterday but the spike started now. Not sure if it's related.

maria: Can someone grab the frontdoor conn pool metrics (conn_active, conn_idle, h2_streams)? Also want auth-proxy error rates — we've had auth token rotations earlier this morning.

oncall-sre: Looking. Frontdoor hosts eu-fw-01/02 show conn_active climb then abrupt resets. auth-proxy shows 429 spikes right before 502s for that tenant. Possible auth backpressure cascade.

kevin: Correlating sample trace: trace-0a1b2c3d shows request fanout to 3 backends, two of them returned 502 from upstream. Upstream logs show TLS handshake timeouts on the same hosts.

aj: customer is pushing retries from their side, making the fanout worse. They asked for a mitigation.

maria: Immediate mitigations: (1) Temporary reduce tenant concurrency via rate-limit on edge for tenant acme-inc, (2) enable 429-to-503 circuit breaker fallback so we can shed load, (3) scale up frontdoor pool if safe. Which can we do quickly?

kevin: I can flip tenant rate-limit rule now (low risk). Also recommend backpressure: set edge config: `upstream_conn_pool_limit = 500` -> increase to 800 for eu-west frontdoor as a short term. Need infra approval for scaling.

tara: Before increasing pools, let's verify auth-proxy isn't leaking sockets. Running `ss -tanp` on auth nodes now — if sockets are TIME_WAIT/clogged increasing pools won't help.

infra-bot: Deploy check: no active deploys to frontdoor or auth-proxy in last 2h.

oncall-sre: Quick runbooks: 1) apply tenant rate-limit 2) enable auth-proxy throttling fallback 3) collect pcap on eu-fw-01 if conn resets continue 4) if TLS handshake timeouts persist, rotate the upstream host and drain the problematic instance.

aj: I've applied tenant rate-limit at 09:20 UTC and asked customer to pause large retries. Failures dropped from 30% -> 8% within 2 mins. Customer acknowledged and paused.

maria: Good. Please capture a sample failing trace with `TRACE_ID=trace-0a1b2c3d` and paste `x-envoy-upstream-service-time`, `upstream_status` and `upstream_host` headers. We want to see which upstream node is failing.

kevin: Pasted headers for that trace: 
```
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 12
upstream_status: 502
upstream_host: 10.12.34.56:443
```

tara: 10.12.34.56 is auth-proxy-03; checking node metrics shows high tcp retransmits and TLS handshake timeout counters. I'm going to drain that node and run a healthcheck.

aj: Customer reports degraded but usable now. I'll keep them updated.

oncall-sre: Drained auth-proxy-03 at 09:28 UTC and healthcheck passed after restart. Post-drain 502s dropped to baseline. Keeping the rate-limit until metrics stable for 30m.

maria: Root cause hypothesis: auth-proxy-03 had transient TLS handshake regressions causing upstream resets; combined with customer-side aggressive retries produced conn pool exhaustion at frontdoor resulting in 502/504s. Action items:
- kevin: add more logging around TLS handshake timeouts and correlate with kernel retransmits (ETA 2d)
- tara: audit keepalive/sysctl on auth nodes, ensure tcp_tw_reuse and proper TIME_WAIT handling (ETA 1d)
- infra: consider autoscaling policy for auth-proxy on high-embeds churn (infra ticket opened)
- aj: coordinate customer follow-up and share postmortem note

aj: I'll update customer and close the escalation once we hit 30m stable. Thanks team :heart:
